answer_1.quote: SpeechLMs enable end-to-end speech interaction... They can perform spoken dialogue, speech translation, automated speech recognition, text-to-speech synthesis, and other downstream tasks.

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation methods are crucial... AUC on perplexity and VERT are employed, ChatGPT score can be utilized to evaluate the quality of the generated speech, and metrics such as ABX, WER, sWUGGY, sBLIMP, and Spoken StoryCloze are used.

answer_3.quote: The ChatGPT score can be utilized to evaluate the quality of the generated speech. In this process, the generated speech is transcribed using state-of-the-art ASR models and then sent to ChatGPT for quality (and diversity) assessment.

answer_4.quote: Mean Opinion Score (MOS) is a key metric in speech evaluation that measures perceived speech quality through human listener ratings on a 1-5 scale, with variations like MMOS, PMOS, and SMOS focusing on naturalness, prosody, and timbre similarity.
answer_4.guideline: Human listeners rate speech on a 1-5 scale for overall quality and specific aspects such as naturalness, prosody, and timbre similarity.
